description: Calculate a Korean saju / Chinese BaZi (Four Pillars of Destiny) chart from a birth date: the year, month, day and hour pillars in hanja and hangul, the day master, five-element counts, ten gods, the 10-year luck cycles, and the solar terms around the birth. Handles solar or lunar (including leap month) dates, month boundaries by solar term, and local solar time correction for the birth place. Calculation only; the input is not stored.

birth_date.description: Birth date YYYY-MM-DD (solar, or lunar if calendar='lunar')

birth_place.description: Birth place: Korean city/district ('서울 강남구', '부산', '전주시') or a world city in English ('Tokyo', 'New York'). Default Seoul

birth_time.description: Birth time HH:mm, 24-hour, local clock time. Omit if unknown (the hour pillar is then left out)

gender.description: Sets the direction of the 10-year luck cycles

lunar_leap_month.description: For lunar dates: true if the month is a leap month (윤달)

timezone.description: IANA time zone with latitude/longitude, e.g. 'Asia/Seoul'

name: calculate_saju
title: Four Pillars (saju) chart calculator
